description: Repeat-use monitor. action=register stores a company/domain/wallet watch and returns an id; action=poll&id=... returns only what CHANGED since the last poll; action=list and action=remove manage watches. State persists across restarts. Price: $0.01 per call in USDC on Base (eip155:8453), paid with x402 in params._meta["x402/payment"]. HTTP: GET https://api.firstmention.uk/s/company-facts/lookup/watch

action.description: register a watch, poll it for changes, list watches, or remove one

q.description: Company name, domain or wallet to watch (for action=register)

name: company_facts__lookup_watch
